title: Basket Goal 1
description: Attention basketball and puzzle fans! Here is a game tailor-made for you - Basket Goal! In this game, you can unleash your basketball skills, shoot the ball into the basket, and feel the joy of victory.
instructions: 1 Drag or use the keyboard to move the basketball 2 Move around the obstacles and make the ball enter the basket 3 Help you relax your mood and adjust your mindset
